question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

A wild cat strike

options.text: A strike that is started by a group of workers without the approval of their union

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"A wild cat strike"** refers to an unauthorized strike by workers, typically not sanctioned by their union. (बिना यूनियन की मंजूरी के हड़ताल)

 
 
• **Example: **The factory faced **a wild cat strike** when the workers walked out demanding better pay.
 
 
 
• **A wild cat strike** means a sudden, unapproved stoppage of work initiated by workers. (बिना पूर्व सूचना के अचानक हड़ताल)
 
 
• **Example: **The company had to shut down operations for a day due to **a wild cat strike** by the employees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A wrong action **(गलत कार्य): An action that is incorrect or unjust.

 
 
• **Example:** He realized it was a wrong action to accuse his friend without evidence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Winsome situation **(आकर्षक स्थिति): A situation that is charming or pleasing.
 
 
• **Example: **The winsome situation at the beach made everyone feel relaxed and happy.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Protest by farmers** (किसानों द्वारा विरोध): A demonstration or protest carried out by farmers.
 
 
• **Example:** The protest by farmers was against the new agricultural policies.
 
 

3d:Tcad,
The correct answer is** Option 4.**
